features: Conversation markers inherit the exact containing project-folder color in ChatGPT and Codex views.
Recent duplicate conversations inherit the folder color through their shared local thread ID when the association is unique.
Five Token-usage shades remain visible across light and dark themes.
ChatGPT Work conversation markers stay inline with titles.
Quota and reset-card times use Asia/Singapore and display the suffix SIN.
rollback_before_this_fix: 回退到GPT文件夹映射修复前.command
restore_policy: After plugin updates, restore this pinned optimized build. Use the previous optimized build only for rollback, and use upstream only when the user explicitly requests it.
cleanup_note: Obsolete pre-SIN rollback artifacts were moved to macOS Trash on 2026-10-04; the pinned build, immediate optimized rollback, and upstream fallback are retained.
